definitions.explanation: The hand tightly closed with fingers curled into the palm. Used literally when describing a physical gesture, and figuratively to convey determination, anger, or readiness to fight.

examples.japanese: {握|にぎ}りこぶし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{握|にぎ}りこぶし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: My clenched fist trembled with anger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、{握|にぎ}りこぶし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The moment the player scored, they thrust a clenched fist into the air.

notes:
Compound of {握|にぎ}り (grasping) + こぶし (fist). Also written as {握|にぎ}り{拳|こぶし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {握|にぎ}りこぶし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ / ⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧ — to make/clench a fist
- {握|にぎ}りこぶし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{上|あ}げる — to raise a fist (in triumph)
- {握|にぎ}りこぶし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ — to hit/bang with a fist

RELATED WORDS:
- こぶし: fist (shorter, slightly more literary; also the name of a type of magnolia)
- ⟦{手|て}のひら→手のひら：05294_tenohira⟧: palm of the hand
